claim: What the hand should feel § (the struck spring): 'a spring wobbles at one rate all the way down, and a pendulum quickens as it settles'; and Two kinds of force §: delay makes a stiff spring unstable, so stiff feels must be computed near the motor. The central claim is touch, which no screen carries; the sound and the stability are what a face can test.

pieces.what: struck spring vs struck pendulum vs braked, heard and plotted; tests the 'one rate vs quickening' claim
pieces.walks_up_from: one flick of a virtual spring with no damping

pieces.what: the feel-lab stability map: stiffness against loop delay, with the unstable region shaded; tests 'delay makes a stiff spring unstable'
pieces.walks_up_from: one spring computed with zero delay

pieces.section: What the hand should feel (the lock)
pieces.what: lock.wav and turntable_bumps beside the feel map; tests whether a click landing on the same point of the wobble is audible as a lock
pieces.walks_up_from: an LFO and a beat click at unrelated rates
